name: Fahim Fuad
now: Surge. Lately the Android export tooling and the particle system. Maybe I'll actually ship a game with it this time...
bio: I'm Fahim Fuad, but most people online know me as Rid/Ridhwan. I'm from Bangladesh, currently persuing major in Chemical Engineering at BUET, and most of my free time goes into writing game engines and C++ libraries.

It started in 2020 with Spike & Electro, which was me following TheCherno's Game Engine series (read: copying/yoinking it). Spike supported OpenGL and DirectX 11(I added this as an extra on top of TheCherno's game engine series; DX11 was fun) as rendering backends, C# scripting and an editor, and it ran fine on a Radeon HD 5570 from 2011(I didn't have a good GPU yet back then to learn Vulkan). Surge is what came after: Vulkan, mobile-first, its own editor, and it exports straight to Android and Windows.
Side note: I was gone from programming world in 2022-2025 to focus on my studies and BUET entrance exam, so yeah my profile was dead during that time span
I mostly write C++. I've worked with Vulkan, OpenGL and DirectX 11, used PhysX before moving to Jolt, and implemented C# & Lua as a scripting language; I sometimes participate in Game Jams for fun
Apart from game engines, I am currently planning to open a YT channel (Come back Dani)
Away from the keyboard: Gym + Burgers + Unhinged personality. That's about it.
